description: Propose adding or removing signers (passkeys and/or EOAs) and/or changing the threshold on a subaccount. EOA adds reference ids returned by `splits auth register-signer`; register the address first, then attach its id here. The same id can be attached to any number of accounts. Primary use case: adding an external (EOA) key so an agent or automation can operate on the account headlessly — passkeys require a biometric 2nd factor that agents cannot provide. A workspace owner can propose any change. An agent that joined as a member rather than an owner (`auth whoami` shows `user.kind: AGENT`, `members list` shows its role) can only propose adding its own EOA signers, with no passkey, removal or threshold change, and an owner signs it. The proposal is created immediately. Sign it on the web via the returned signUrl, or with 'transactions sign <id>' from a local key that is already a signer on the account. On a multisig, run 'transactions update-gas-estimation <id>' before the last signature. Size thresholds assuming any threshold-meeting signer set, agent keys included, can change signers. Poll 'transactions get <id>' to watch status transition from CREATED to EXECUTED. If this returns 400 SMART_ACCOUNT_MERKLE_TRANSACTION_IN_PROGRESS, call 'transactions list --account <address>' to find the pending proposal; it must be signed or cancelled before retrying. Recovery / resetting signers stays web-only — no CLI or API route exists. (Recovery is the owning account's contract-enforced right — see 'splits accounts'; the root account has no owner and cannot be recovered from above.) Updates apply to every active network on the org automatically. Use 'accounts signers <address>' to discover existing signer IDs (passkeys and EOAs), and `auth signers` to list the EOA ids registered under the acting user. Requires an owner-scoped API key, except for an agent that joined as a member adding its own EOA signers.

addEoaAddresses.description: Comma-separated EOA signer addresses to attach. Each must already be registered to your acting user via `auth register-signer`. Convenience alternative to `--add-eoa-signer-ids` when you have the address but not the id.

addEoaSignerIds.description: Preferred. Comma-separated EOA signer ids (from `auth register-signer` / `auth signers`) to attach. The same id can be attached to multiple accounts.

addPasskeyIds.description: Comma-separated passkey authenticator IDs to add (from 'members signers')

removeEoaIds.description: Comma-separated EOA signer IDs (from 'accounts signers <address>') to remove

removePasskeyIds.description: Comma-separated passkey authenticator IDs to remove (from 'members signers')

threshold.description: New signer threshold. Unchanged if omitted.

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: accounts_update-signers
